dataset_name: Copernicus ERA5 Reanalysis & ECMWF Integrated Forecasting System (IFS)
access_method: Dynamic REST API queries with in-memory TTL caching
use_in_system: Multi-temporal antecedent rainfall (1h, 3h, 6h, 24h, 72h, 7d, 30d) and climatological anomaly
known_limitations: Deep Himalayan valleys experience micro-orographic cloudbursts sub-grid to 10km cells
